latest_release.name: UEFITool / UEFIExtract / UEFIFind NE A76
latest_release.body:
A bugfix release with minor additions, AMD images parsing is still not re-enabled.

- Fixed multiple security issues in third-party parsing libraries by updating to latest versions (LZMA SDK 26.05, brotli 1.2.1).
- Fixed misaligned access in the parser code.
